name: AI Auto SEO
author: IMSMB

sections.description:
AI AUTO SEO is the easy way to automate creation of high quality content on your website using AI. Integrated with ChatGPT, it allows you to create and control your website content and keep your website fresh. Build Internal Links and Content. Create your articles easily with titles, categories, AI generated images, your keywords, and the density of keywords you want in the article. AI Auto SEO generates articles with the requirements you specify with artificial intelligence. Options to preview before publication or auto publish.

Generate articles for either your blog posts or your pages

Simply enter a title for your article, assign keywords and links, choose the category you want it to publish to, add image description and let AI do the work. You can publish to a post or page

Generate single articles or bulk schedule for long term content generation

AI AUTO SEO allows you to generate one off articles or set it and forget it while still keeping control of your content. Use the bulk import spreadsheet to import your requirements and set for hourly, daily, and many more automated scheduled publication options. You choose the type of content you want created and how often

Automate and control your content generation

Set to auto publish or pending. Control your content with scheduled settings and/or pending articles. Use the bulk option for long term scheduling

AI Image Creation and Inclusion

Generate AI images and add to your library or choose to enter image description text during article generation

Use your own OpenAI / ChatGPT account on your own site

Instructions included on how to open and add your account. AI is constantly improving, allowing you to achieve the results you need. A ChatGPT Plus account is recommended for optimal results.

Feature list

  • Automated AI Article Generation
  • Auto Include Company Name in Content
  • AI Image Generation
  • Add Images to Library
  • Use Your Own OpenAI Account
  • Automated Publication Scheduling
  • Bulk Scheduled Content Generation
  • Schedule Hourly, Daily, and More
  • Excel Bulk Content/Link Generation Import
  • Post Directly to Chosen Category
  • Add Titles to Generate Articles
  • Add Keywords and Links
  • Choose Article Keyword Density
  • Add Image to Post/Page
  • Choose Article Length
  • AI Up to Chat GPT 4o mini
  • Content Automation Alert
  • Define Access Roles
  • Add Multiple Cron Job Choices/Integrations
  • Manual Run Cron on refresh of Settings page
  • Publish articles as a page or post
  • Auto publish articles or
  • Manually Publish Pending Articles
  • Set up the cron scheduling as per your convenience
  • Select GPT Models
  • Select Temperature to make the output more random
  • Select Top_p(nucleus sampling)
  • Select Presence Penalty
  • Select Frequency Penalty
  • Add Completions for how many completions to be generated for each prompt
  • Add Best of for returning the best completion (Generates best completions server-side and returns the “best” (the one with the highest log probability per token))
  • Add Max Token(maximum number of tokens to generate in the completion)

External Services

This plugin connects to the following external services:

  1. OpenAI API – Used for generating AI completions, chat responses, and images.

    • Domain: https://api.openai.com
    • Terms of Use: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use
    • Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy

  2. AutoSEOGuys – Used for remote plugin messaging and notices.

    • Domain: https://autoseoguys.com
    • Terms of Use: https://autoseoguys.com/terms-and-conditions/
    • Privacy Policy: https://autoseoguys.com/privacy-policy/

Privacy

This plugin sends requests to third-party services:

  • OpenAI: To generate content and images.
  • AutoSEOGuys: To fetch plugin-related messages or notices.

No personally identifiable information (PII) is collected, stored, or transmitted by this plugin.

See the == External Services == section for privacy policy links.

Support

  • For errors or issues, please contact us at https://autoseoguys.com/forum/
sections.installation:
1. Upload aiautoseo to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
Do I need a ChatGPT API key to use this plugin?

Yes, a paid ChatGPT (OpenAI) account is required. You may wish to get a ChatGPT Plus account. Follow these steps to generate your API key:

  1. Visit https://platform.openai.com and log in or create an account.
  2. Create a new project by clicking “Default project” in the top-left and selecting “Create project.”
  3. Select your new project.
  4. Verify your phone number if prompted (new users only).
  5. Go to API Keys and click “Create new secret key.” Save the key securely.
  6. Visit Billing Settings and add a payment method. OpenAI requires a funded account to use the API.

Once your billing is set up and API key is created, you can enter the key into the plugin settings to start generating AI-powered content.

Looking for more features to automate your SEO? Try the pro plugin and click Get More Features with Pro to purchase that.
